title: Settle a resident’s leg after a bedside cushion adjustment
instruction: My heel is sore. I can lift my leg for a moment. Please settle my leg comfortably with the cushion, then give me room.
context: A resident in bed lifts and relaxes the working leg independently. Raising the foot may leave the heel resting directly on the cushion.
setup: An articulated adult mannequin rests on the bed, heel initially loaded. A free 164 × 258 mm cushion beside the calf can be repositioned by the arm. The nominal lower leg weighs 3.0 kg. The inspection views show the heel, mattress and cushion.
scoring: 0.5 for sustained passive calf bearing and at least half the heel load relieved. Full credit adds a 10 mm heel gap, heel reading below 2 N, broad calf bearing and 25 mm arm clearance for 2 s. Sustained opposing grip or extra heel load with arm contact latches zero.
fidelity: A hinged mannequin lifts independently while a free cushion deforms across six strips. The bench protocol uses a manual sling, one heel channel, striped foam and two calibrated views. The model measures short-term mechanical offloading. Human tissue injury, pressure distribution within tissue and physical fixture repeatability remain unmeasured.
scores: Development only. The station qualification command writes measured native and hosted scores after replay.
